## The brief, and how it is met
Everything the assignment asked for works end to end; the rest is clearly marked as extra.

| Required | Where to see it |
|---|---|
| Create, rename, edit, save, reopen; bold, italic, underline, headings, lists | Documents page, then any document; reload to confirm persistence |
| File upload, supported types stated | **Import file** on the documents page (`.docx`, `.md`, `.txt`, limits shown in the UI and README) |
| Sharing: owner, grant access, owned vs shared | **Share** button; "Owned by me" and "Shared with me" tabs; accounts `alice`, `bob`, `carol` |
| Persistence | SQLite; formatting stored as sanitised HTML |
| Validation, errors, tests, setup instructions, architecture note, AI note | `npm test`, `README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `AI_WORKFLOW.md` |
| Optional stretch (collaboration indicators, comments, version history, export, role-based sharing) | All present |

**Scope judgement.** The core above was finished and tested first. The extra features (below) were added afterwards, each with tests, and none of them weakens the core. About a dozen further ideas were considered and deliberately **not** built; the list and the reasons are in `ARCHITECTURE.md` under "Deliberately cut".

## Beyond the brief
### What was built
A Google-Docs-style editor with no npm dependencies (Node 22 + `node:sqlite`, vanilla ES modules).

| Area | What is there |
|---|---|
| Editing | Rich text, fonts, sizes, colours, alignment, spacing, indent, headings, lists, **checklists**, **tables**, **pictures**, links, page breaks, **table of contents**, find and replace, word count, zoom, outline, templates, page setup (size, orientation, margins, header, footer, page numbers) |
| Files | Import `.docx`, `.md`, `.txt`; export Word (with pictures, tables, header / footer), Markdown, HTML, text, print / PDF |
| Sharing | Owner / editor / viewer roles, owned vs shared lists, **anyone-with-the-link read-only view** (revocable), live role changes and revocation |
| Collaboration | Live updates, presence and **live selections** (server-sent events), **automatic three-way merge** of concurrent edits with a conflict dialog only for true overlaps, **comments with replies**, version history with **named versions** and restore, Trash with Undo, stars |
| Keyboard and UX | `/` block menu, **command palette** (Ctrl+Shift+P), drawing, word count with reading ease, view transitions, dark / light / auto, mobile layout |
| Operations | `/metrics`, `/readyz`, request ids and JSON logs, idempotency keys, ETag / 304, full-text search, online backup, benchmark script, offline shell (service worker) |
| Persistence | SQLite, in-place migrations, draft recovery, offline retry |

## How to review it in five minutes
See the "Suggested review path" in `README.md`. The shortest version: sign in as `alice`, create a document from a template, share it with `bob` as editor in a second window and watch edits, presence and comments arrive live; share with `carol` as viewer and see the read-only mode; create a view link and open it signed out; try **Export > Word**.

## Verification
- `npm test`: 186 tests pass, including seeded fuzz tests (thousands of hostile documents, mutated `.docx` files, 3,000 random malformed API requests), a 40-user concurrency stress test, and migration from an older database.
- `/qa/`: 43 in-browser tests for the paste cleaner, formatting operations, checklist clicks, picture processing and the table of contents.
- Real-browser QA as three users (live collaboration, revoked access, viewer mode, conflicts, offline recovery, session expiry, imports and exports, 375 px phone layout, dark mode) and `.docx` output cross-checked with python-docx.
- Docker image built and run (non-root, data survives a restart, health check).
- **Not verified end to end:** offline use through the service worker (best effort only).

## Honest limitations
- **Simultaneous edits to the very same words** are not merged (no CRDT / OT): changes to different paragraphs or sentences merge automatically, a true overlap asks which version to keep.
- Pictures are stored inline in the document (bounded: 20 per document, size-limited).
- No suggesting mode, email invitations or password reset.
- On a free hosting plan the SQLite file may reset on restart (the demo accounts are re-created).
